item.title: America Needs a Bigger Navy. It’s Starting with More Shipbuilders.
item.description: Secretary of the Navy John Phelan stressed that America’s shipyards would need 250,000 additional workers in the near future—to be accomplished through apprenticeships, vocational training, and competitive pay. item.title: Sorry, Secretary Hegseth: The US Military Is Still Getting More ‘Diverse’
item.description: As wealthier (and disproportionately white) Americans have lost interest in military service in the volunteer era, minority groups are serving in steadily greater numbers.
